channel.title: The Kyiv Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kyiv Independent (kyivindependent.com)

item.title: Drone attack sparks fire at oil refinery in southern Russia, officials say
item.description: Flames engulfed one of the tanks at the Albashneft oil refinery in Novominskaya and burned an adjacent area of about 150 square meters, the Krasnodar Krai Operational Headquarters said.

item.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,265,900 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
item.description: The number includes 770 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

item.title: At least 4 killed, 25 injured in Russian attacks against Ukraine over past day
item.description: Russian troops launched an Iskander-M ballistic missile and 105 drones of various types, including about 60 Shahed drones, the Air Force said on Feb. 28. It reported downing 96 drones in the north, south, and east of the country.

item.title: Reporter's notebook: What a factory says about Ukraine’s economy
item.description: The western part of war-torn Ukraine lies in the space between normalcy and reality. More tourists, more construction, more skiing. item.title: Russia condemns US attack on its ally Iran as 'unprovoked act of aggression'
item.description: Russia and Iran have deepened cooperation in recent years, with Tehran supplying drones and other military equipment used by Russian forces in the war against Ukraine.

item.title: Ukraine sanctions Russian postal services delivering to occupied territories, Zelensky says
item.description: Among the companies sanctioned are Russian DPD service and Freightlink, joint-stock companies registered in Russia, according to a document attached to a decree published on the Office's website, signed by Zelensky on Feb. 27.

item.title: 'Freedom to the Iranian people' — Kyiv voices support for US-led strikes on Iran
item.description: "The reason for the current events is precisely the violence and arbitrariness of the Iranian regime, in particular the murders and repressions against peaceful protesters, which have become particularly large-scale in recent months," the Foreign Ministry said in its Feb. 28 statement.

item.title: Russia would accept security guarantees for Ukraine, Budanov says
item.description: "At past negotiations, the Russian side directly said that they would accept the security guarantees offered to Ukraine by the U.S.," the head of the President's Office, Kyrylo Budanov, said on Feb. 28.

item.title: US, Israeli missiles strike Iran — here's what it means for Russia
item.description: "Our objective is to defend the American people by eliminating imminent threats from the Iranian regime," Trump said in a video posted to his Truth Social, confirming U.S. invovlement in the strikes.

item.title: Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei is dead, Iranian state media confirms
item.description: "Khamenei, one of the most evil people in History, is dead," Trump wrote on Truth Social on Feb. 28. He also said the bombing of Iran would continue for at least the next week.
